title: 24 hours, 7 days a Week of Constant Support

sections.markdown: Along with resources provided at the installations, such as counselors, chaplains, OSCAR team members, and other advisors, the below resources are available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, and provide support to service members and their families.

sections.heading: Suicide Prevention
sections.markdown:
### Veterans/Military Crisis Line

Free, confidential resource for all service members and veterans.

[www.veteranscrisisline.net](http://www.veteranscrisisline.net/)

Call [988](tel:988), then press 1.
Send a text message to [838255](sms:838255).
Chat online at [VeteransCrisisLine.net/chat](https://www.veteranscrisisline.net/chat).

**_Calling from Overseas?_**

In Europe: Call [+1 844-702-5495](tel:+18447025495) (off base) or DSN 988 (on base)
In Southwest Asia: Call [+1 855-422-7719](tel:+18554227719) (off base) or DSN 988 (on base)
In Korea: Call [080-855-5118](tel:0808555118) or DSN 118 (on base)
In Pacific: Call [+1 844-702-5493](tel:+18447025493) (off base) or DSN 988 (on base)

If you're calling outside the United States, Canada, or Mexico, and are off base, you're responsible for long-distance international charges from your carrier, even if you're dialing a toll-free number.

U.S. text codes, such as 838255, only work if you're on a U.S.-based service provider with an international service plan that allows texting to U.S. short codes from outside the United States.

sections.heading: Substance Assessment and Counseling Program
sections.markdown:
### Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration (SAMHSA)

Free, confidential, 24/7 treatment referral and information service for individuals and families facing mental and/or substance use disorders.

[www.samhsa.gov](http://www.samhsa.gov/)

Call [800-662-HELP (4357)](tel:8006624357)
Text your ZIP code to [435748](sms:435748)

sections.heading: Sexual Assault Prevention and Response
sections.markdown:
### DoD Safe Helpline

Free, confidential 24/7 services to support DoD community members and families affected by sexual assault.

[www.safehelpline.org](http://www.safehelpline.org/)

Call [877-995-5247](tel:8779955247).
Visit [www.safehelpline.org](http://www.safehelpline.org/) and explore the group chat and app.

### Veteran Affairs Military Sexual Trauma Resources

You don't have to be enrolled in VA benefits or health care to connect.

[www.mentalhealth.va.gov/msthome/index.asp](http://www.mentalhealth.va.gov/msthome/index.asp)

[**Installation 24/7 SAPR Support Lines**](/marine-family-support/prevention-and-counseling/sexual-assault-prevention-and-response#talkToSomeoneNow)

For all other locations, call the DoD Safe Helpline ([877-995-5247](tel:8779955247)).

sections.heading: Family Advocacy Program
sections.markdown:
National Domestic Violence Hotline Number: [(800) 799-7233](tel:8007997233)

[Military OneSource's Domestic Abuse Victim Advocate Locator](https://www.militaryonesource.mil/resources/tools/domestic-abuse-victim-advocate-locator/)

[**Installation 24/7 Victim Advocacy Helplines**](/marine-family-support/prevention-and-counseling/domestic-abuse#talkToSomeoneNow)

For all other locations, use the Military OneSource Domestic Abuse Victim Advocate Locator.

sections.heading: Military Onesource
sections.markdown:
Military OneSource is a free service to Marines (active duty, veteran, wounded/ill/injured), attached sailors, family, and naval personnel supporting Marine Units. The Military OneSource Line is a confidential phone and chat support service that operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

[www.militaryonesource.mil](http://www.militaryonesource.mil/)

Call [800-342-9647](tel:8003429647)
